about_the_game:
KEY FEATURES

  • Impactful & wacky perks - With overpowered synergies. 

  • Fresh - Each battle is a mini-roguelike. Campaign is strategy-lite.

  • Replayable - Unlock new characters and items with diverse playstyles.

  • Twitch API - Viewers can join as NPC's and choose a loadout!

NEVER ALONE

Allies crash into battle with style, in drop pods.

BE A CARDMANCER

  • Real time. Spend energy to play cards - either summon allies, cast spells or just start blasting with conventional weaponry. 

  • Channel your inner bard. Each character can play unique hymns to affect the battle whilst recharging their energy.

WACKY SPELLS

Each element has unique effects. You can even reverse gravity!

GAMEPLAY LOOP

  • Upgrade your fleet & your own ship at base.

  • Choose a planet on the dynamic campaign map. With a powerful fleet, you can expect safer journeys.

  • Board your ship & survive the journey into battle!

  • Eject from your ship & reinforce humanity!

FUN DETAILS

Destroy an enemy ship in low orbit, it'll crash onto the battlefield.

ENLIST TODAY

Remove the demonic scourge from our universe and restore prosperity to mankind.

ADDITIONAL DETAILS

  • Objective variety. Assault, Rescue, KOTH & special encounters.

  • Collect. Gather DEMONIC BLOOD to construct buildings mid-battle.

  • Randomised enemy compositions. Enemies who can deflect bullets, shapeshifters, enemy artillery, bosses & more.

  • Challenges. Unlock special rewards.

  • Curses! The enemy will periodically curse the battlefield with different effects.

  • Adapt. Cobble together a build from a choice of randomised perks and cards each battle.

  • Reinforcements. Recruit mercenaries and heavy support units to join you on heavily infested planets.

Minimum:
  • OS *: Microsoft 64-bit Windows 7 or newer
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11 compliant graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Become a Cardmancer & lead an army of NPC's to battle demons across space. Choose a planet and engage in ship-to-ship combat, then eject in your drop pod to join the chaos.
